def get_all_pricing(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):

def add_pricing(product_id: int, old_rate: float, new_rate: float, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    margin = ((new_rate - old_rate) / old_rate) * 100
    status = "Increased" if new_rate > old_rate else "Decreased"
    
    new_pricing = Pricing(
        product_id=product_id,
        old_rate=old_rate,
        new_rate=new_rate,
        margin_percentage=margin,
        price_change_status=status
    )

    db.commit()
    return {"message": "Pricing added successfully"}
